verses.text: Once you were dead because of your wrongdoing and sins.
You used to live in them, following the ways of this world. You obeyed the ruler of the powers of the air. He is the spirit now at work in those who disobey God.
All of us once lived like them. We followed the desires of our sinful nature and our thoughts. Like everyone else, we deserved God's anger.
But God is rich in mercy, and he loves us with a great love.
Even when we were dead in our sins, he made us alive with Christ. It is by grace you have been saved.
God raised us up with Christ and seated us with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus.
He did this so that in the ages to come he could show how great his grace is. He shows it through his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.
It is by grace you have been saved, through faith. It does not come from you. It is God's gift.
It does not come from what you do, so no one can boast.
We are God's handiwork. He created us in Christ Jesus to do good works, which he prepared long ago for us to do.
So remember what you were before. You were born Gentiles. The Jews, who are circumcised in the body by human hands, called you "the uncircumcised".
At that time you were without Christ. You were not part of the people of Israel. You were outsiders to the agreements of God's promise. You had no hope, and you were without God in the world.
But now in Christ Jesus, you who were once far away have been brought near through the blood of Christ.
Christ himself is our peace. He made the two groups one. He broke down the wall of hatred that divided us.
In his own body he set aside the law with its commands and rules. He did this to make one new people out of the two, and so make peace.
Through the cross he brought both of them back to God in one body. On the cross he put an end to the hatred.
He came and preached peace to you who were far away, and peace to those who were near.
Through him we both can come to the Father by one Spirit.
So you are no longer strangers and outsiders. You are citizens together with God's people, and members of God's family.
You are built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets. Christ Jesus himself is the main cornerstone.
In him the whole building is joined together. It grows into a holy temple in the Lord.
In him you too are being built together into a home where God lives by his Spirit.
